description: Context profile for generating interactive data graphs. Merges the contour line-art visual language with the atmospheric color palette from the silhouette images.

graph_philosophy.approach: Data as form — graph elements behave like the flowing contour lines: they suggest shape, movement, and density rather than simply encoding values mechanically
graph_philosophy.mood: Calm scientific curiosity — precise but never clinical
graph_philosophy.interaction_metaphor: Revealing layers of a form, like peeling contour lines back to see the data beneath

chart_types_supported.style_note: Multiple series rendered as flowing parallel lines at varying opacity — mimics the contour line aesthetic directly
Fill uses a gradient from the warm or cool palette register at 15% opacity; stroke is full opacity
Points rendered as small open circles with hairline strokes; density clusters visually recall compressed contour regions
Edges as thin contour lines; nodes as minimal circles; layout should feel organic/biomorphic not grid-like
Concentric lines radiating outward, variable spacing encodes value — directly evokes contour topography

visual_encoding.grid_style: dotted or very faint solid — never dominant

hover.behavior: Highlight hovered line/point; sibling elements reduce to 20% opacity
hover.effect: Soft glow using current series color — radial gradient bloom, not a CSS box-shadow

tooltip.style: Minimal floating card — no border, subtle backdrop-blur, monospace values

zoom_pan.zoom_style: Line weights stay constant during zoom — only data positions scale

animation_on_load.description: Lines draw themselves from left to right using SVG stroke-dashoffset animation — directly mirrors the contour drawing aesthetic

legend.style: inline dots (4px open circles) + DM Mono labels
legend.toggle_behavior: Click to hide/show series; hidden series fade out via opacity transition

breakpoints.mobile: < 640px — hide secondary grid lines, reduce label density

library_recommendations.name: D3.js
library_recommendations.reason: Maximum control over SVG contour-style line rendering and custom animations

library_recommendations.name: Recharts
library_recommendations.reason: React-friendly, good baseline for line/area charts with custom SVG overrides

library_recommendations.name: Observable Plot
library_recommendations.reason: Elegant defaults close to the desired aesthetic with minimal config

do: Animate lines drawing in on load — this is the signature interaction
Use opacity as a primary encoding dimension (density = importance)
Keep axes and grid as quiet as possible — let the data lines speak
Apply grain texture overlay to the chart background at 3–5% opacity
dont: Use filled bars or pie charts — line forms only
Add heavy grid lines or borders around the chart
Use bold or heavy font weights in labels
